limitations.title: Review before using an output
limitations.description: Generative video is probabilistic. Inspect every result instead of assuming the prompt was reconstructed exactly.
items: Faces, hands, fine text, repeated objects, and reflections may drift across frames.
Reference media guides the result but does not guarantee pixel-level identity, timing, or composition.
Longer, denser prompts can introduce competing actions; simplify the shot before adding detail.
Generated audio should be reviewed for timing, intelligibility, brand safety, and usage context.

items.question: Which Seedance 2.5 modes can the Agent use?
items.answer: Agent Starter maps five explicit routes: text-to-video, image-to-video, reference-to-video, video edit, and video extend. The Agent chooses from your instruction; an attachment alone does not determine its role.

items.question: Which settings are supported here?
items.answer: The workspace exposes 4–30 second durations, 480p and 720p resolution, the listed aspect ratios, generated audio, one or two frame images for image-to-video, and mixed reference input up to 30 images, 10 videos, and 10 audio files with a 50-file total. Edit and extend each require one source video.

items.question: Are the gallery clips verified Seedance 2.5 outputs?
items.answer: No. They are clearly labeled creative evaluation references from the project's R2 library and are provided to study motion and prompt structure.

items.question: Why is this page not indexed yet?
